method: A vision model was shown each ground-tier crop and transcribed what is legible on it. No reader output was consulted while transcribing, so the reference is independent of the thing it scores.
note: `names` are the shop and business names a sign pipeline is meant to recover, which is what the game renders. `alsoLegible` records other real text in the crop -- street signs, house numbers, window decals -- so a reading matching one of those is scored as correct-but-not-a-name rather than as an invention. Anything matching neither is an invention.

crops.comment: ScooterCentre appears three times: the main fascia and two small logos. i Boenda appears on the pink fascia and again in the window.
Restaurant Manoto appears on the fascia and on three window decals. LA BASTA appears on the fascia and in the window.
The fascia panel crops the leading F, showing REDDY FRYDAY; the hanging sign and the chip-cone both show FREDDY FRYDAY, so the name is Freddy Fryday.
O TEM BA appears five times along the awning and once in the window. The subtitle after it is not legible at this resolution -- it is a ramen and gyoza line -- so it is deliberately not transcribed.
